decisions.story_title: Zoho patches eight ManageEngine flaws in DDI Central and ADAudit Plus
decisions.reason: Real vendor advisory with eight ManageEngine issues including Cisco router command injection and SQL injection; distinct product set from the existing ADSelfService Plus stories.
November 2026 Patch Tuesday roundup; one of many outlets covering the same release, so it belongs in the canonical Patch Tuesday story.
Reports observed in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-124194 in Outlook; matches the dedicated zero-day story.
The Register coverage of the same November update and the KB513206 install failures; fold into the Patch Tuesday story rather than minting an update-quality story.
Corroborates the ongoing ConnectWise ScreenConnect campaign against MSPs with rogue remote-access tooling.
BYOD ransomware claim and record count for the Vanderbilt incident; belongs in the existing campus-wide attack story.
Details the N-central RMM takedown after the Able2Shell disclosure; same incident.

decisions.story_title: Go 1.27.4 and 1.26.11 fix 12 security issues including cgo code execution
decisions.reason: Concrete Go toolchain security release with CVE-2026-97033 (cgo build-time code execution) and an HTTP/1 server crash fix; not covered by any existing story.
Interlock claim against the Garden Valley School Division with the leaked data classes enumerated; the primary source for this story.
Canonical Ubuntu/Canonical status post for CVE-2026-98432, a CVE already tracked in that story.
Adds eight more revoked eMudhra intermediate CAs after the private-key mishap to the existing certificate story.

decisions.story_title: BrickLink taken offline after suspected security incident
decisions.reason: BBC-reported takedown of the LEGO marketplace; a live platform outage with no existing story.
Aggregated SIGINT digest post; the rigged coding assignment and abused AI tool entry into the Binance heist is already covered by multiple existing Binance stories. No new primary detail.
Streamer/podcast commentary about PHP2Shell, not reporting.
Conference attendance announcement, no security substance.
AI-drafted summary of a Blind Eagle campaign with no primary attribution in the post; existing Blind Eagle stories already cover the actor's loader infrastructure.
